goal: Report internal errors instead of transaction-not-found when disk reads fail
Prevents downstream callers and wallets from misinterpreting node I/O errors as nonexistent transactions
reviewability: Waiting on author reply to an open objection from yuvicc
agreement: General agreement on separating missing transactions from read errors
Concept approval for distinguishing not-found from I/O failures (musaHaruna, yuvicc)
Nonblocking objection: pruned block queries return I/O error instead of block not available (yuvicc)

categories.name: indexes
why: P3 because it distinguishes index lookup corruption from missing transactions
It addresses an uncommon disk read error without altering index data structures or synchronization

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it stops RPC and REST callers from falsely reporting missing transactions on disk errors
Downstream services avoid misinterpreting node I/O corruption though the failure mode is uncommon
